market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a former governor of the province and a multi-term lawmaker from the major opposition Democratic Party. The market-implied 0.8% chance appears drastically low even considering his 2022 re-election loss and the uncertain nomination process. A more realistic probability for a politician of his stature is at least high single digits, implying a substantial edge for Yes.
evidence_points: Yang Seung-jo served as governor (2018–2022) and is a three-term National Assembly member, giving him strong name recognition.
South Chungcheong is a competitive battleground where Democratic candidates often receive 40%+ of the vote, so his general election floor if nominated is nontrivial.
The current political instability (President Yoon’s impeachment) may weaken the conservative PPP and boost Democratic prospects in 2026 local elections.
